text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Afonso Dhlakama, leader of Mozambique's former rebel movement Renamo, told Noticias that the current wave of demonstrations against the high cost of living and alleged misgovernment by the ruling Frelimo Party will spread to Maputo in the near future. He threatened that demonstrators would march on President Joaquim Chissano's office.

- A magistrate in the northern Mozambican province of Nampula on Tuesday conditionally released the 15 people arrested during an illegal demonstration on Monday organised by Renamo. Among those released is the Renamo Nampula provincial political delegate, Issufo Momade.
